[[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] '''Jendon''' was a former test [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who flew various [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] prototypes, and was the first pilot to fly a [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]]. He was a member of [[Onyx Squadron/Legends|Onyx Squadron]] as [[Onyx 1]] alongside [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Yorr/Legends|Yorr]], and was the copilot of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[ST 321|personal shuttle]] in the months before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] Jendon and Yorr brought Vader to [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]].

==Behind the scenes==
Jendon appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], where he was portrayed by actor [[Mike Havord]].
